content: Next.js on Vercel: serverless functions have cold starts 500ms-2s+. maxDuration configurable per route. Hobby plan: 100GB-hrs execution, ~1000 image optimizations/month, 100GB bandwidth. images.maximumResponseBody configurable (default 50MB). Edge runtime available but limited Node.js API. Function bundle size limit 250MB. waitUntil returns undefined in minimalMode (serverless) - cannot keep invocation alive.
